text:
Residents:
Felix (student, early 20s): Out for classes approx 08:40–14:30 daily. Studies at home in the afternoon/evening. Hobbies: board games, cycling, family calls, reading.
Aisha (retired, 60s): Home most of the day. Morning walk, afternoon errands. Hobbies: cycling, gaming, photography. Cares for the household dog.

Object Locations & Patterns:
Bathroom:
- Shelf: detergent, hair dryer (Aisha), laundry basket, skincare (Felix), toiletry bag (Felix).
- Medicine Cabinet: first aid kit, medication (Aisha).
- Sink: soap, toothbrush holder, glass (Aisha).
- Towel Rack: towels for Aisha and Felix.

Bedroom 1:
- Desk: notebook/pen (Aisha), plant pot, textbook (Felix), laptop (Felix), pen (Felix), mug (Felix).
- Dresser: headphones (Aisha).
- Nightstand: book (Felix), tablet (Aisha), tablet (Felix), phone (Aisha), headphones (Felix), glass (Felix), glasses (Felix).
- Bed/Floor/Wardrobe: Empty.

Entry:
- Floor: backpack, helmet, jacket, water bottle (all Felix); umbrellas (Aisha/Felix).
- Hook: hat, helmet, jacket, scarf (all Aisha), dog leash.
- Table: bike locks (Aisha/Felix), keys (Aisha/Felix), sunglasses (Felix), wallets (Aisha/Felix).
- Shoe Rack: shoes (Felix), shoes (Aisha).

Kitchen:
- Counter: cutting board, kettle, pan, plant pot, toaster, wall clock.
- Dish Rack: water bottle (Aisha), glass (Felix).
- Floor: dog bowl.
- Table: glass (Felix), water bottle (Felix).
- Pantry: dog food, recipe book, shopping bag.
- Sink: bowl/glass/mug/plate (Felix), mug/plate (Aisha), snack bowl.
- Cupboard: bowl (Aisha), bowl (Felix), pan, plate (Aisha), plate (Felix).
- Drawer: knife, spatula.
- Chair: Empty.

Living:
- Armchair: cushion.
- Bookshelf: board game, camera (Aisha), picture frame, puzzle box, vase.
- Coffee Table: coasters, magazine (Felix), tissue box, phone (Felix), mug (Felix), glasses (Felix).
- Couch: blanket, cushion.
- Floor: dog toy.
- Side Table: lamp, plant pot.
- TV Stand: controller/headset (Aisha), remote.

Storage:
- Floor: vacuum cleaner.
- Shelf: duster.

Notes:
Day 1 03:00 patrol showed significant tidying: Felix’s laptop, pen, and mug moved from entry to desk; his headphones moved to nightstand. Aisha’s bowl and Felix’s bowl/plate moved to cupboard. Kitchen utensils (knife, spatula) moved to drawer. Aisha’s shoes moved to shoe rack. Dog leash moved to hook. Phones appeared: Aisha’s on nightstand, Felix’s on coffee table.
Daytime movements: Felix’s glasses moved to bathroom shelf (07:49) then coffee table (21:49) then nightstand (22:49). Felix’s glass moved from dish rack to kitchen table (14:58) then nightstand (22:45). Felix’s water bottle moved from dish rack to kitchen table (19:46). Felix’s mug moved from desk to coffee table (22:06).
Felix’s study items (laptop, pen, mug) are now consolidated on the desk. Evening relaxation items (glasses, mug, phone) are on the coffee table or nightstand. Aisha’s phone is on the nightstand. Cycling gear remains in entry. Dog items distributed as before.
